title: Gears from rules: spur to bevel, checked before they're printed
summary: @rulecad/gears: involute spur gears, racks, rings, helical and herringbone gears, planetaries, worms and bevels from their module and teeth; meshed in phase in assemblies, measured from their drawn teeth, and their teeth analysed by finite elements. A sampler plate to print, a focus slider and a spool winder; measurements to come
